optimizedDescription.value: GraphStore: persistencia gráfica atómica con búsquedas por identidad, referencias y frescura incremental.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules

- GraphStore abstract class in domain/ports/; storagePath constructor; adapters own physical schema.
- Persist FileNode content, SymbolNode, SpecNode, DocumentNode, required relation families and graph metadata.
- open() prepares; close() idempotent; unopened/closed ops throw StoreNotOpenError. Provider-owned recreate() resets backend and rotates generation; incompatible schemas reject ordinary reads.
- upsertFile, removeFile, upsertSpec, removeSpec atomic; addRelations additive; incremental updates compare contentHash. Bulk commits once, dedupes, rebuilds FTS once.
- Query files/symbols/import-call-type-hierarchy/spec-coverage, SymbolQuery, statistics, reference/binding/coverage snapshots and batched affected/coverage lookup.
- searchSymbols, searchSpecs, searchDocuments: 1-based snippets; lexical expansion whitespace, :, /, _, ., -, Camel/Pascal; rank identity > exact > prefix > suffix > component > substring > BM25; filter before limit. Content candidate query indexed/bounded, never full-file scan.
- Persist IndexedInputObservation plus stale latches; clear only successful index. COVERS_SYMBOL may carry metadata.stale.

## Constraints

- Backend-agnostic port; consumers no backend mechanics/direct deletion.
- Deterministic batch order; no @specd/core; errors extend CodeGraphError.
